name: PRAGMA foreign_key_check
rule: SQLite's own check of every foreign key returns no row.
handout: Foreign keys point to existing rows

name: Diagnosis.patient_id equals its admission's patient
rule: Diagnosis is the only child table that stores both patient_id and admission_id; the two must agree (the composite foreign key enforces it).

name: Admission: status agrees with discharge_time
rule: discharged / deceased admissions have a discharge_time; active admissions do not.

name: No discharge record on an active / unknown-status admission
rule: An admission that is not completed (active or NULL status) has no DischargeRecord.

name: Discharge record time equals the admission's discharge_time
rule: DischargeRecord.discharge_time = Admission.discharge_time. WARNING: the two come from different source files, so a difference is reported, not rejected.

name: Completed admission has a discharge record
rule: Every discharged / deceased admission has a DischargeRecord. WARNING: no DischargeRecord was imported for this admission (it may have been quarantined in Task 2); the admission is kept and reported.

name: Deceased admission: patient not marked alive
rule: An admission with status 'deceased' belongs to a patient whose life_status is not 'alive'. WARNING: the status comes from the admission source, life_status from the patient source.

name: Admission: discharge_time not before admit_time
rule: When discharge_time is set, discharge_time >= admit_time.
handout: Discharge after admission, unit exit after entry

name: UnitStay: exit_time not before entry_time
rule: When exit_time is set, exit_time >= entry_time.
handout: Discharge after admission, unit exit after entry

name: UnitStay inside the admission period
rule: A unit stay enters at or after admit_time and, when the admission is discharged, enters and exits at or before its discharge_time.

name: DischargeRecord: discharge_time not before admit_time
rule: A discharge record is never earlier than its admission's admit_time.
handout: Discharge after admission, unit exit after entry

name: RadiologyExamination.exam_time inside the admission period
rule: RadiologyExamination.exam_time is not before the admission's admit_time and, when the admission has a discharge_time, not after it.

name: SurgicalProcedure.procedure_time inside the admission period
rule: SurgicalProcedure.procedure_time is not before the admission's admit_time and, when the admission has a discharge_time, not after it.

name: TriageAssessment.triage_time inside the admission period
rule: TriageAssessment.triage_time is not before the admission's admit_time and, when the admission has a discharge_time, not after it.

name: DiagnosticOrder.order_time inside the admission period
rule: DiagnosticOrder.order_time is not before the admission's admit_time and, when the admission has a discharge_time, not after it. Known: a few records have a timestamp outside the admission period (the offending rows are days before admit or after discharge); they are kept and reported as a warning, not rejected.

name: Diagnosis.diagnosis_time inside the admission period
rule: Diagnosis.diagnosis_time is not before the admission's admit_time and, when the admission has a discharge_time, not after it. Known: a few records have a timestamp outside the admission period (the offending rows are days before admit or after discharge); they are kept and reported as a warning, not rejected.

name: ClinicalNote.note_time inside the admission period
rule: ClinicalNote.note_time is not before the admission's admit_time and, when the admission has a discharge_time, not after it. Known: a few records have a timestamp outside the admission period (the offending rows are days before admit or after discharge); they are kept and reported as a warning, not rejected.

name: Completed admission without a primary ICD-9 diagnosis
rule: Every discharged / deceased admission has at least one primary diagnosis. No primary ICD-9 diagnosis was imported for this completed admission. Its diagnoses may have been quarantined in Task 2 (duplicates, chronology, invalid dates, unknown ICD-9 codes, orphan professionals, parent quarantined) or none was recorded as primary. LIMITATION: it is never invented.
handout: Every completed admission has a primary diagnosis

name: of which: no diagnosis of any kind
rule: Completed admission with no Diagnosis row at all.
handout: Every completed admission has a primary diagnosis

name: of which: secondary diagnoses only
rule: Completed admission with Diagnosis rows, all of them secondary.
handout: Every completed admission has a primary diagnosis

name: of which: source system A
rule: Completed admission without a primary diagnosis, from source A.
handout: Every completed admission has a primary diagnosis

name: of which: source system B
rule: Completed admission without a primary diagnosis, from source B.
handout: Every completed admission has a primary diagnosis

name: of which: source system C
rule: Completed admission without a primary diagnosis, from source C.
handout: Every completed admission has a primary diagnosis

name: of which: source system D
rule: Completed admission without a primary diagnosis, from source D.
handout: Every completed admission has a primary diagnosis

name: Admission with unknown (NULL) status
rule: admission_status is not NULL. LIMITATION: Task 2 flagged their status as inconsistent (status_inconsistent); Task 3 set it to unknown (flag admission_status_set_unknown) because no discharge time could be recovered; these admissions are kept, excluded from the completed-admission checks (a discharge record on one is still a FAIL), and never guessed.

name: Patients with more than one admission exist
rule: At least one patient has 2+ admissions (history kept, not collapsed to one).
handout: Multiple admissions and diagnoses per patient preserved

name: Admissions with more than one diagnosis exist
rule: At least one admission has 2+ diagnoses (all kept, not collapsed to one).
handout: Multiple admissions and diagnoses per patient preserved
